scope: Independent analysis of bounded raw-session retrieval, 9 multi-session questions; no answer generation
hypotheses_to_test: Chunk-level top-k may spend multiple slots on a single session; test session diversity with matched retrieval budgets.
Compare broader candidate retrieval and reranking on held-out questions; preserve baseline and measure regressions.
